message.skyabyss.storyteller.struck: "...Stop that. Bullying an old woman won't shake anything loose."
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.first:
Oh, a face I don't know. A traveler?
There's nothing in this village, but the sky is wide. ...Stay a while.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.deja_vu:
...Oh.
I feel I've seen that face before. ...No, an old woman's fancy. I keep having the same dream lately.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.deja_vu_so:
...You came to hear the rest of that song, didn't you.
...How strange. I wonder why I thought so.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.shadow0:
Oh, you followed the smoke, did you. ...I don't know your face.
Travelers stopping by to warm themselves is nothing unusual. Stay a while.
How do you know it will be today?
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.shadow0_b:
There's nothing here, but the sky is wide.
Keep an eye on the sky today. At midday, especially, if it's clear. ...Not that I like to recommend it.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.shadow0_wh:
My knee aches. And the bell, too. Since morning it has been ringing softly, with no wind at all.
...I'd be glad if it were only an old woman's fancy.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.shadow_fir:
...That face. You saw it, didn't you. The midday sky.
This is where those who have seen it come first. ...Well, come and warm yourself.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.shadow_wai:
You haven't seen it yet. No need to hurry.
In the daytime, the sky isn't going anywhere.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.menu.shado: Something crossed above the clouds at midday.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.menu.song: Are there any old songs in this village?
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.menu.song_: I want to know the rest of the counting song.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.menu.watch: At night, someone was standing far off.
Is there anything to beware of at night?
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.menu.custo: Tell me the customs of this village.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.menu.seen: I saw something on the way that troubled me.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.menu: Is there something you want to ask?
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.capital1:
Shut, yes. This was a capital once. ...Not many call it that anymore.
There was a line here called the Skywatchers who kept the nation. When the shadow passed they rang the bell and wrote down what they saw. That was all they were.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.capital2:
That line is gone. Of the keep only the tower still lives. I am the last bell keeper.
The houses are empty. Use whichever you like. ...The doors that are shut cannot be opened yet. They will open when the time comes.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.shadow1:
The sky, is it.
...On a clear day it sometimes goes dark all at once. The sheep crouch, the birds fall silent. Something crosses above the clouds.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.shadow2:
No one knows what it is. Those who looked up all hold their tongues.
But in the years the shadow passes, a "song" is always heard. From beyond the far sky, low and long.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.shadow3:
There's a curious traveler who chases that song. Since last night they've kept a fire at the edge of the village.
If you want to hear it, follow the smoke. ...Not that I'd advise it.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.shadow_why:
Those who only watch the sky stop watching their feet.
...I feel that one will go up into the sky someday too.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.chaser_hin:
At the edge of the village. You'll see the smoke.
...Once that one starts talking, it goes on a while.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.song1:
A song? There's the one the children sing while bouncing a ball.
One, at midday comes the shade
Two, lie down beside the sheep
Three, don't you look up
Four, at night there comes the moon
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.song2.curi: I'd like to know the rest.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.song2:
...I don't know what comes after five. Nor did my mother, nor hers.
There's no one left who knows the rest.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.song_curio:
You're a curious one.
...Look for old pages. In the chests of village houses, scraps of paper sleep that no one remembers writing.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.song_child:
Yes. A children's song.
...Though someone must have wanted the children to remember it.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.sub_offer:
The rest of the song... All I know is the song and a few old sayings.
Gather the old words left in the villages and write them in that notebook of yours. Someday the rest may turn up.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.song_done:
You've gathered quite a lot. ...Let me see.
The seventh night. The flattened peak. The figure standing in the dark. ...They all seem to face the same way as the song.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.song_done2:
Five...
...It's no use. It's right on the tip of my tongue. When I try to remember, it feels as if the sky goes dark.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.watcher:
If you're outside alone at night, sometimes someone is standing far away.
They call it "the Watcher." If you don't meet its eyes, it does nothing. ...So they say.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.watcher2:
But my grandmother used to say:
it isn't watching us. It's "remembering" us.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.calendar:
Customs? ...There's just one.
On the seventh night, shut your door and don't go out. The margins of the old calendar say the same thing every seven days.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.calendar2:
No one knows why the seventh. I've never heard of a house that didn't keep it, either.
...Though maybe that's only because none of them are left.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.book:
An old notebook. Let me see.
"Write it down before you forget"... is it.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.book2:
I feel I've seen this hand somewhere. ...No, my imagination.
Keep it safe. What's written stays, even when you forget.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.whale:
A mountain of rock, swimming in the sky?
...I see. So you've seen the singer.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.whale2:
My mother used to say it comes down when it's come to fetch someone.
She never said who.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.back:
A town, on its back... People lived there? Up in the sky, with no ground of their own.
...If they were born there and died there, then for them the whale was the whole world.
I found the remains of a camp.
Great hollows lay in a row in the ground.
The ground shook in the night.
A huge rib cage stood on a hill.
A song came down from the night sky.
I saw a mountain of rock swimming in the sky.
There were ruins of a town on the whale's back.
Every door in this city is shut.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.camp0:
That camp, is it. ...The fire's always cold, isn't it.
There's only ever the trace of someone having used it. No one has ever seen them use it.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.prints0:
Footprints, is it.
Did you count them? Stop at three. They say the ones who went looking for a fourth never came back.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.steps0:
It shook, did it. ...Three times, wasn't it?
On nights like that, I cover my ears and sing the counting song. By the time I reach "three," it has always gone quiet.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.bones0:
Bones, is it. Standing in an arc, were they.
Some find comfort in the sight of dead things. I'm the opposite. If a thing can end, it must have begun, mustn't it?
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.song0:
...You heard it, then. The song from the sky.
On nights when it comes down, some of the stars go out. My mother said something was passing overhead.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.song0_b:
I always thought we sang "three, don't you look up" so that children wouldn't see what can't be seen.
Now I think it may be so that we aren't seen.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.song0_c:
I fear that if I called its name, it would turn around.
...So I've decided not to call it.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.fragment:
...You came back.
Show me what's in your hand.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.fragment2:
Warm... It's beating. As if it were alive.
The old tales say the key to the sky's door was split in four. One the whale had. The rest... who knows where.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.fragment_v:
...Do you remember the first line of the counting song? "One, at noon the shadow comes."
Perhaps it was the whale's shadow all along. The children sang it without knowing.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.fragment3:
You're going to the sky, aren't you. ...I won't stop you.
Only, be careful on the seventh night.
message.skyabyss.whale_chaser.struck: "Hey, quit it. You'll get ash in the fire."
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_first:
...Hm? Ah, you're not from the village.
Warm yourself by the fire. I'm Isana. I'm waiting for the whale. The whale of rock that swims in the sky.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_deja:
Have we met?
...No. When you only watch the sky, you forget faces. I'm Isana. Don't mind me.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_menu.wh: The storyteller told me about you.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_menu.pe: Did you see anything on your travels?
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_menu.ba: I rode on the whale's back.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_menu.he: Is there anything I can do for you?
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_menu.sh: I brought scales of the whale.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_menu.se: I saw something strange on the way.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_seen_me: I found the remains of a camp.
Great hollows lay in a row in the ground.
The ground shook in the night.
A huge rib cage stood on a hill.
A song came down from the night sky.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_camp:
That camp. When I stopped there, no one was around either.
The fire was cold, but the bedroll was warm, as if someone had only just got up.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_prints:
Three in a row, weren't there. I looked beyond them too.
I found nothing. ...Finding nothing is the worst part.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_steps:
Last night. The water by the fire shook three times, slowly.
...It wasn't the whale. Whales don't walk.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_bones:
That slab. ...It wasn't me. The hand isn't mine.
The song stopped, it says. I've chased that song a long time, and never once thought it had stopped.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_song:
You heard it, last night's song. That's the one I chase.
But it was closer than ever. ...Too close, I thought.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_song2:
A close song means a close whale.
Once you're ready, keep your eyes on the sky. Brace yourself, too. I'm trying to myself.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_whale1:
I've been chasing the whale for years now.
That low song from the far sky in the shadow years... its singer is a whale of rock. Someone told me long ago there's a town on its back.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_whale2:
Sometimes it comes down below the clouds and lets down a chain long enough to reach the ground.
I've... never once caught it. It always comes down over someone far away.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_whale_i:
You cannot climb the chain bare-handed. ...The traveller who came here before wore iron.
The cairns from the north gate over the hills are that one's road. Where they end is called the Bone Pit.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_whale3:
Get ready before the whale comes down. Iron first. Follow the cairns to the Bone Pit.
The traveling artisan knows about blades, the storyteller about shields. ...Once you're ready, maybe it'll come over you.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_afraid:
Of course I am.
...But when I look up at it, it feels like I'm being called. As if there's somewhere I have to go.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_when:
When you hear the song, look at the sky. The whale sings before it comes down.
Have yourself ready by then. ...It comes down where there are people. As if it's come to fetch someone.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_peak:
Up north, I saw a peak with its summit gone.
It hadn't crumbled. It was flat, as if shaved from above, and the cut rock was still white. ...That wasn't the whale. It was something bigger.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_saw:
You saw it!
...I see. I envy you. I always lose it just before I get there.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_back:
You rode it...!
What was on its back?
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_back_to:
A town... So there were people.
Maybe that song is the one they used to hear.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_back_gu:
Guards...
So there's something being protected. Deep inside the whale.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_back_se:
...I see. Maybe that's how it should be.
See it with my own eyes, you mean.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_shards_:
I have a favor to ask. ...Could you bring me a few stones from its back?
Pieces of the whale's body. Three will do. I want to touch them. To feel the place I never reached.
I'll take good care of it.

So this is... the whale.
Just cold stone. ...And yet, held to my ear, I think I hear the song, far off. Thank you. Take this as thanks. I may not need it anymore.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_fragmen:
...That thing in your hand. It's beating, faintly.
Did something stop, deep inside the whale? ...This morning I thought its song had changed, just a little.
About the writing on that page...

Show it to the old storyteller too. She must know something.
Me... I'll watch the sky here a while longer.

The page from the pack in the pit. ...It has been on my mind too.
That hand looked like the writing in the whalebone captain's log. ...No, it cannot be. That log is centuries old.
quest.skyabyss.main_song.title: The Song Beneath the Clouds
quest.skyabyss.main_song.summary: Follow the smoke to the lodge, and trace where the shadow in the sky leads.
quest.skyabyss.main_song.done: The fragment is faintly warm, and it beats. The other three must be held deep inside the other titans.
quest.skyabyss.main_song.follow_smoke.jo:
All that was left at the camp was a single notebook.
Far off, a thin column of smoke rises. Now and then a bell is carried on the wind.
quest.skyabyss.main_song.watch_sky.journ:
The storyteller at the Bell Lodge told me to keep an eye on the sky today.
The bell has been ringing softly since morning, she said, though there is no wind.
quest.skyabyss.main_song.watch_sky.look: Look up at the sky on a clear midday
quest.skyabyss.main_song.ask_storyteller:
On a clear day, the sky went dark. Something crossed above the clouds.
The storyteller might know something.
Ask the storyteller about the sky
quest.skyabyss.main_song.find_chaser.jou:
In the years the shadow passes, a "song" is always heard from the far sky.
A traveler who chases that song keeps a fire a little way off. Follow the smoke.
quest.skyabyss.main_song.find_chaser.lea: The storyteller says a traveler who chases the sky's song keeps a fire at the edge of the village.
quest.skyabyss.main_song.find_chaser.tal: Talk to the Whale Chaser by the fire
quest.skyabyss.main_song.prepare.journal:
Isana said the chain cannot be climbed bare-handed. The traveller who came before wore iron, and carried a honed blade and a shield.
Get ready the same way before the whale comes down. Isana knows about the iron, the artisan about the blade, the storyteller about the shield.
quest.skyabyss.main_song.prepare.lead: Isana: "Get ready before the whale comes. Iron, a honed blade, and a shield."
quest.skyabyss.main_song.see_whale.journ:
You are ready: iron on your back, a honed blade, a shield. Dressed like the traveller who came before.
The singer is said to be a whale of rock that swims in the sky. Sometimes it comes below the clouds and lets down a chain. When you hear the song, look at the sky, Isana said.
quest.skyabyss.main_song.see_whale.lead: You are ready. All that is left is to wait for Isana's whale.
quest.skyabyss.main_song.see_whale.see: Listen for the song; look for the whale
quest.skyabyss.main_song.see_whale.see.w: Look up and wait for the stone whale
quest.skyabyss.main_song.board.journal:
The stone whale is right there. Isana said the chain would take you up onto its back.
It is the place Isana never once reached.
quest.skyabyss.main_song.board.lead: If the chain reaches you, you can climb to its back. The place Isana never once reached.
quest.skyabyss.main_song.board.ride: Climb the chain to its back
quest.skyabyss.main_song.inscriptions.jo:
On its back lay a ruined town. Past the entrance, three trial rooms follow one after another.
At the entrance of each, the people of the back left an inscription. Cross all three and go deeper.
quest.skyabyss.main_song.inscriptions.le: A ruined town lies on its back. The inscriptions in the three trial rooms may tell who lived here.
quest.skyabyss.main_song.inscriptions.re: Clear the trials, read their words
quest.skyabyss.main_song.heart.journal:
The three trials are behind me. Past the sentry captain, something is beating.
Something, they say, was laid to rest beside the heartbeat.
quest.skyabyss.main_song.heart.lead: Beyond the three trials and the sentry captain, something beats.
quest.skyabyss.main_song.heart.still: Find what beats deep inside the body
quest.skyabyss.main_song.heart.fragment: Take what was laid beside the heartbeat
quest.skyabyss.main_song.return.journal:
The fragment is faintly warm.
Return to the village and tell them.
quest.skyabyss.main_song.return.lead: The fragment in your hand is faintly warm. Tell the storyteller and Isana.
quest.skyabyss.main_song.return.storytel: Show the fragment to the storyteller
quest.skyabyss.main_song.return.chaser: Go and show the fragment to Isana
quest.skyabyss.sub_song.title: The Rest of the Counting Song
quest.skyabyss.sub_song.summary: Gather the old words left in the villages and write them in the book of lore.
quest.skyabyss.sub_song.done: No one yet knows what comes after five.
quest.skyabyss.sub_song.gather.journal:
The storyteller knows only the counting song and a few old sayings.
Torn pages asleep in village chests, the words of people. Gather the old words into the book of lore.
quest.skyabyss.sub_song.gather.words: Record the village sayings in the book of lore
quest.skyabyss.sub_song.tell.journal:
The village sayings are all in the book of lore.
Go and show the storyteller.
quest.skyabyss.sub_song.tell.talk: Show the storyteller the words you gathered
quest.skyabyss.sub_shards.title: Pieces of the Whale
quest.skyabyss.sub_shards.summary: Bring back Stone Whale Scales from the whale's back for Isana.
quest.skyabyss.sub_shards.done: Isana held the stones to the fire and was silent for a long time.
quest.skyabyss.sub_shards.gather.journal:
Isana wants to feel the place he never reached.
The guards on the back sometimes drop shards of the stone whale.
quest.skyabyss.sub_shards.deliver.journa:
You have three scales.
Take them to Isana's fire.
gui.skyabyss.quest.days: Taken on day %s, finished on day %s
gui.skyabyss.quest.lore_hint: What you learn goes in the book of lore.
message.skyabyss.quest.open_hint: Press %s to open the quest log
message.skyabyss.artisan.struck: "...Do not make me stop. The needle slips."
message.skyabyss.heartbeat_ward.remade: You had your heartbeat ward woven again.
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.a_menu: Something you need? My hands will keep moving.
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.a_menu.hammer: May I ask about that hammer?
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.a_menu.whet: What about the whetstone at your hip?
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.a_hammer:
This hammer? The haft has been changed three times. The head, never. ...Or once? I have no memory of that part.
A hammer does not remember how often it fell. The hand does.
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.a_whet:
A whetstone wears down before the blade does. Every time you hone, it rounds off. That is fine. That is what it is for.
...Some people name the things that wear away. I do not. Name it, and the hand starts to spare it.
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.a_hands:
The hands remember. How the needle goes in, how the hammer falls, which way a knot lies. ...Who taught me, the hands will not say.
Still, when I hold a tool, I feel I am standing on the owner's side. Odd. Forget I said it.
